Corollary
[Limit-set ergodicity for tame groups] 1. Corollary 8.12.4\group harmonic functionsSource: thurston:page-0236 If $N$ is geometrically tame and $\Gamma =\pi _1N$, then $L_\Gamma $ has measure zero or one; in the latter case $\Gamma $ acts ergodically on $S^2_\infty $.
Proof

\sketch Harmonically extend the characteristic function of an invariant measurable subset of $L_\Gamma $. The boundary minimum principle makes this extension constant when $L_\Gamma =S^2$ and forces the subset to have measure zero otherwise.

□
